text: Over Red Lake, Ontario, a warning chimes. Low fuel pressure in the left engine. The captain turns for Winnipeg. Then the left engine stops. A few minutes later, the right engine stops too. The engines also make the plane's electricity, so the glass screens in the cockpit go dark. Even the transponder dies, so controllers on the ground can no longer see how high they are. And a warning sounds that nobody on board had ever heard before. All engines out.
